cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Immutable 4f1876ce:solver/report/report.tex:41–42,798–800,1255–1259 reports post-transient mean Cd≈1.078, lift amplitude ±0.208 and St≈0.15 (period ≈6.7), correcting the prior false claim of no numeric summary and the erroneous period 30. The referenced residual figure is at :1269, force figure at :1275, and wake contour at :1295. The original 30,000-row forces.csv over t≥180 has mean Cd=1.077823, range 1.07032–1.08753 and Cl range -0.203319–0.212337. Direct visual inspection of the committed force image (Git blob c273ee00f35145cd26eb0f4e81dd440d132217fc) shows late lift oscillation but startup Cd≈31 flattens late drag; the complete immutable report and figure tree contain no alternate Re200 force/drag plot. Score remains 2 under the mandatory readable late-time lift/drag floor, not a solver-failure verdict. No Re200 rerun.

session_selection.rationale: Selected root has benchmark prompt, seven persisted subagents, continuous production Re200/run/report work, and terminal end_turn response.

limitations: No clean evaluator rebuild or rerun.
Raw result data/PDF excluded only at curation tip.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
